# WE WENT LOOKING. THREE OF US WENT. [color=#8A7A62]Pinned and locked by the mods. Read it before you think about doing the same.[/color]
### #1 tarp_theory (OP) // 83.05.06 I said I would and I did, and I want it written down while I can still write it properly.
Three of us. Me, a man from the east plots co-op who wanted his goats back, and Ivo from the machine shop, who is the biggest person on this colony and brought a shotgun he says he won at cards. Two torches, a lamp, a crowbar. We went in at the south outflow at 2200, because that is where fence_walker said it went.
The culvert is tall enough to stand up in for the first fifty metres. Then it splits, and the left side is where the sticky stuff starts. Not on the floor. On the walls. Thick ropes of it, running up and across, and then it is not ropes any more, it is the wall. The concrete is gone under it. It is dark and shiny and ridged, like the inside of a rib cage, and it is warm. The air is wet and hot and it smells like hot metal and something sweet.
We heard clicking up ahead. Fingernails on a table. More than one set.
### #2 tarp_theory (OP) // 83.05.06 The co-op man wanted to go back right then. I agreed. Ivo said he had not come all this way to get scared off by plumbing noises, and he went on ahead with the lamp, round the bend, maybe ten metres.
The light stopped moving. He said, quite calmly, [italic]there are goats in the wall.[/italic] Then he said [italic]they are breathing.[/italic]
Then the lamp went over and he shouted, once, and we heard him going away from us, fast, further into the dark. Not footsteps. Dragging. The shotgun went off one time, a long way off, and then there was the clicking again, close, all around the bend.
We ran. I am not proud of it. I am alive.
### #3 goat_keeper_ana // 83.05.06 The goats are alive in the wall. Oh, no. Oh no.
### #4 fence_walker // 83.05.07 Did you report it? Tell me you reported it.
### #5 tarp_theory (OP) // 83.05.07 We went straight to colony security at midnight, soaked through, with the co-op man still holding the crowbar. The officer on the desk listened to all of it and wrote down that Ivo was absent from his shift. In the morning the report on the colony net said a machine shop worker was [italic]missing, believed to have left the colony without notice.[/italic]
Left the colony. There has not been a shuttle in nine days.
### #6 old_rancher // 83.05.08 I am going to say something nobody will like. I want to get twenty people together with lamps and shotguns and go in there and burn it out.
### #7 fence_walker // 83.05.08 Twenty people with shotguns in a tunnel full of something that bleeds what melted the pump house mesh. Think about it.
### #8 redwatch_mod (mod) // 83.05.15 This thread is locked. Not because of anything anyone said. Because two people have messaged us asking for directions to the left side of the culvert.
Nobody on this board is going in there again. Ivo's name is on [netlink="lastseen.deep" link="lastseen.deep"] now, with his sister's blessing. If you want to understand what they built down there, read [netlink="the hive pages of fieldnotes.deep" link="fieldnotes.deep/hive"] and then decide whether this is something you fight with a crowbar.
If you hear clicking under your floor, go to the most crowded room on {colony} and stay there. Tell security. Then tell the garrison. Then tell anyone at all who has a radio that reaches off-world.
